help: 🤖 Claude on Telegram Any text goes to the active session. Photos and files are attached to it. Access /{{password}} <password> — unlock the bot /{{lock}} — lock it now Sessions /{{change}} — choose the working directory (or /{{change}} name) /{{sessions}} — sessions in the current directory: switch, new here, pause all Answers from other sessions are kept (📬) and delivered when you switch. /{{new}} <path> [name] — open a session in any directory /{{repos}} — projects; open a new session /{{resume}} — resume a recent Claude conversation /{{pause}} [name] — pause an idle session (keeps the conversation) /{{pause}} all — pause every idle session in the current directory /{{status}} — active session, model and context /{{screen}} — show the terminal now /{{cancel}} — interrupt Claude Claude Code /model — change model (or /model opus) /effort — effort level (or /effort high) /usage — plan usage /clear — clear the session context /{{lang}} — language The bot locks itself after {{hours}} h without use and whenever it restarts.
